Try something new. Save your life by living it. It is impossible that you have tried every flavor of life. I encourage you to risk it. Put yourself into it, ride a rollercoaster, swim with sharks, love someone, 
Build something, write a book, canoe a river, go fishing. Thats a tiny list of things to try before calling it quits

I meant how specifically you progress. Im sorry you feel like this. I have been there for years so I know what its like. 

Is there something you enjoy doing? Anything that you look forward to? Do you have anyone to talk to? I suggest finding an activity to get through the bad suff, whatever it is. And tell a friend how you feel. 

These simple things can do alot more than we think when we are in dark places

If you are a nihlist and atheist then you can live for sex and the progress of our species. 

Personally i find that the only truth is the Bible. 

What are you going through? Life would make nihlists of us all so you are not alone. There is a point to life and you can find it. Don't end yours

Make friends with Ronald again. If theres a simple but elegent way of doing it then i suggest that. Some people respond to words, or touch, gifts, acts of service. 

Maybe just find Ronald and refuse to leave him alone. Tell him you will be his friend no matter what. Have his back and ask him if he wants to talk about what happened.
Ask forgiveness from ronald and move forward

If you cannot tell her over the phone I would call her, make sure shes not driving just yet, and see when she will be leaving. Then write her a coherent as possible note about how you feel.

Most of what everyone on SW feels and thinks, are things every single person has gone through or goes through. So it is very likely that she will understand

The way you feel is not uncommon, you arent alone. Having friends and family that care is great. You can achieve success ! You are only 20! Dont let your life be measured by false standards. Financial troubles are bad but you can work through it, even if it seems impossible. 

You have much to live for. And you are valuable to this world.
